d:
Bihar Anti Drug Campaign : bihar men nashe ke khilaph ek mahine tak vishesh abhiyan chalaya jaega. mukhyamantri samrat chaudhri ne patna men 27 aktubar se 26 navanbar tak chalne vale is abhiyan ki shuruaat ki.
Abhiyan ke tahat logon ko nashe ke dushprabhavon ke prati jagruk karne ke sath nashe ke karobar par karravaee karne par bhi jor diya jaega. mukhyamantri ne adhikariyon ko sakhti baratne aur abhiyan ko ganv-ganv, ghar-ghar tak pahunchane ka nirdesh diya hai.
